title: Trees as a nitrogen safety net
query: How do tree roots in agroforestry systems intercept nitrate below crop rooting depth, and under what soil and management conditions does this reduce nitrogen leaching? Compare mechanisms, field evidence, and limitations.

title: Cooling a city without wasting water
query: How should a hot, water-stressed city balance urban trees, cool roofs, and reflective pavements to reduce human heat exposure? Compare mechanisms, field evidence, water demand, and possible unintended effects.

title: Batteries beyond lithium
query: Where are sodium-ion batteries a credible alternative to lithium iron phosphate batteries? Compare resource availability, energy density, cold-weather performance, safety, lifecycle impacts, and stationary versus mobility applications.

title: A reef that can recover
query: Which interventions have the strongest evidence for improving coral reef resilience to marine heatwaves? Compare local water-quality management, marine protection, assisted restoration, and their limits under continued warming.

title: The hidden cost of desalination
query: What determines the environmental footprint of seawater reverse-osmosis desalination? Synthesize evidence on electricity, intake impacts, brine discharge, renewable integration, and mitigation tradeoffs.

title: Carbon in a handful of soil
query: How do cover crops and reduced tillage affect soil carbon storage, and why do reported climate benefits differ across studies? Explain measurement depth, permanence, nitrous oxide, climate, and farming-system tradeoffs.

title: Making heat pumps work in winter
query: What determines whether residential heat pumps reduce costs and emissions in cold climates? Compare seasonal efficiency, building insulation, refrigerants, electricity mix, peak demand, and backup heating.

title: A second life for solar panels
query: How can end-of-life crystalline-silicon solar panels be reused or recycled responsibly? Compare reuse testing, material recovery technologies, economics, transport, and environmental tradeoffs.

title: Restoring the river's floodplain
query: When does reconnecting rivers to floodplains reduce downstream flood risk and improve ecosystems? Explain hydrological mechanisms, field evidence, land-use constraints, and situations where benefits are limited.

title: Microplastics in wastewater
query: How effectively do wastewater treatment processes remove microplastics, and where do the captured particles go? Compare primary treatment, biological treatment, membrane filtration, sludge handling, and measurement uncertainty.

title: A quieter ocean
query: How does commercial shipping noise affect marine mammals, and which vessel or operational interventions have the strongest evidence for reducing exposure? Compare speed reduction, propeller design, routing, and implementation tradeoffs.

title: Long-duration energy storage
query: How do pumped hydro, flow batteries, and hydrogen compare for long-duration renewable electricity storage? Distinguish round-trip efficiency, storage duration, siting constraints, costs, and grid-service requirements.

title: Food waste into useful resources
query: When is anaerobic digestion of food waste environmentally preferable to composting? Compare methane leakage, displaced energy, nutrient recovery, digestate management, transport, and lifecycle assessment boundaries.

title: Designing safer wildlife crossings
query: What makes wildlife crossings effective at reducing road mortality and maintaining habitat connectivity? Compare overpasses, underpasses, fencing, species-specific design, monitoring, and evidence quality.

title: Steel with less carbon
query: What are the main technical and environmental tradeoffs between hydrogen direct-reduced iron and scrap-based electric arc furnaces for low-carbon steel? Explain electricity requirements, feedstock quality, emissions boundaries, and scaling constraints.

title: Seagrass and coastal carbon
query: How reliable is seagrass restoration as a climate-mitigation strategy? Compare carbon burial, avoided losses, restoration success, permanence, measurement challenges, and biodiversity benefits.

title: Clean air in classrooms
query: How do ventilation and portable filtration influence indoor particle exposure in classrooms? Compare outdoor-air supply, HEPA filtration, carbon dioxide monitoring, noise, energy demand, and real-world implementation evidence.

title: Learning from retrieval
query: How do retrieval-augmented language models differ from long-context language models for evidence-grounded question answering? Compare retrieval failures, context utilization, citation support, cost, and evaluation methods.

title: Building with timber responsibly
query: Under what conditions can mass-timber construction reduce lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions relative to concrete and steel? Explain forest sourcing, carbon accounting, substitution, fire design, and end-of-life assumptions.

title: Forecasting a changing monsoon
query: Why is seasonal monsoon rainfall difficult to forecast, and how do ocean conditions, land feedbacks, and climate change affect predictability? Compare dynamical and statistical approaches and explain regional uncertainty.
